regional.source: WAQI regional stations 25-40 km outside the basin (Nuwara Eliya / Kegalle / Kurunegala), AQI back-converted
regional.note: The three Sri Lankan stations logged alongside are 25-40 km outside the basin. They sample the regional/transboundary background (~76% of Kandy PM2.5, f_local=0.24), so they are context for B(t) — not a check on the Kandy field.

about: DEMONSTRATION. The frozen area-anchored Kandy model (trained on 2019-2023) driven by NASA GEOS-CF forecast fields. Kandy has no public in-basin monitoring station, so this forecast is NOT scored locally and nobody here can check it. What stands behind it is the same recipe scored at Medellin against 15 withheld stations, where it beat 24 h persistence by +0.120 (RMSE 5.71 vs 6.49) on a year it was not trained on. That is a Medellin number in a different pollution regime, so it bounds the method, not this city. Intervals are widened by 1.35x because Kandy is out-of-regime: the sensorless anchor's nominal 90% interval covers only 70.7% of the local record, and the widening restores 90% there. The regional series shown alongside comes from stations 25-40 km OUTSIDE the basin: it tracks the transboundary background (~76% of Kandy's PM2.5), not the city field, and is never scored against the forecast.

evidence.title: Medellín, 2023 — 15 withheld stations
evidence.protocol: Same recipe, same drivers. Anchor trained on 2019-2022 only and scored on 2023 hours it never saw; the 24 h persistence baseline gets no look-ahead either.
evidence.caveat: An earlier run of this backtest reported +0.223. That run trained on hours inside its own evaluation year; the clean split shown here roughly halves the number. All pre-registered gates still pass.
evidence.not_a_kandy_number: Skill measured at Medellín. Kandy is a different regime (regional/transboundary-dominated, f_local~0.25, vs Medellín's local-emission dominance), so this bounds the method, not the Kandy forecast.

ood_widen.why: The forecast quantile heads were fitted in-regime on the locked 2019-2023 Kandy anchor. Kandy is out-of-regime versus every city the method was validated on, and the one measurable consequence at Kandy is that the sensorless anchor's nominal 90% interval covers only 70.7% of the local record. k=1.35 is the inflation that restores 90% coverage on that record (n=1215 days; identical by direct search and split-conformal).
ood_widen.transfer: Measured on the DAILY sensorless anchor, applied to the HOURLY forecast anchor — a disclosed transfer, the same status as the wind prior. Displayed intervals are widened; the raw model interval is recoverable as median +/- (shown - median)/k.

conformal_summary.floor_note: the measured out-of-distribution factor 1.35 is a floor; adaptation can widen but never narrow below it

conformal.note: Per-lead adaptive conformal factors. Verified against the runner's own analysis (nowcast) tier, which measures driver shift, NOT against observations -- Kandy has none. The static measured factor is a floor.
